Theme

Kitchen, meals & drinks

thaw verb

classical

liquefaciō, liquefacere

verb, third conjugation

make liquid

Used here for thawing frozen produce; phrases about thawing are descriptive applications.

Other words

  • dissolvō, dissolvere, dissolvī, dissolūtum — melt, thaw (something)

    verb, third conjugation, transitive · also used · classical · Lucr. 6.964: glaciem (of the sun; Lewis & Short); Hor. C. 1.9.5: dissolve frīgus (Lewis & Short); Traupman 393

  • tābēscō, tābēscere, tābuī — thaw, melt away (intransitive)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. N.D. 2.26: mollītur tepefactus et tābēscit calōre (Lewis & Short); Traupman 393

See also freeze.
